method: Complete ordered inventory and baseline coordinates were inspected, and the acquired official basin schematic was visually assessed for sufficient target coverage. No geometric registration, shoreline repair or name-boundary partition is claimed.

observations: All 62 ordered source positions and all 62 baseline positions, including the closing position, were considered. The polygon has a northwestern arm, a broader northeastern lobe, an elongated central reach and a long southeastern/downstream extension.

The northern perimeter reaches approximately 47.578188°N, the western arm approximately 79.655812°W, and the downstream endpoint approximately 46.827265°N, 79.156129°W. These are generalized inventory limits, not an official lake-boundary definition.
The ORRPB map places numbered reservoir 4 on the western part of the Ottawa River basin, and its table calls that reservoir Timiskaming. This supports regional context only.

The small basin schematic does not resolve the two northern arms, detailed eastern shore or the downstream endpoint against the full polygon. No full-feature correspondence or exhaustive constituent-water assessment can be completed from it.
records.assessment: Whole-feature correspondence remains pending because the inspected map is too generalized to establish all arms and downstream scope.

included_evidence_limit: Included records contain official bibliographic references and own factual observations. Original publications and inspection materials are not included. Public offline checks do not reproduce visual map judgments.
